newsitem.title: USA: New York Harbor jet fuel diffs firm in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: New York Harbor jet fuel diffs firm in quiet trade.

text.p: Prompt New York Harbor jet fuel differentials inched higher by late Friday in lackluster trading.
Prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 1.75 cents over the July NYMEX heating oil, up slightly from the previous day.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel differentials stood near unchanged on the day, with prompt barrels talked between 0.25 to 0.50 cents under the July, according to traders.
On the NYMEX, July heating oil futures gained 0.02 cent to settle at 51.65 cents a gallon.
